title: Bistability, Absolute Concentration Robustness, and Hysteresis in Dual-Site Futile Cycles with Bifunctional Enzymes
summary: Bifunctional enzymes, which catalyze both the forward and reverse steps of a substrate modification reaction, arise naturally in bacterial two-component signaling systems and metabolic regulation. Beyond their well-known role in conferring absolute concentration robustness (ACR) on substrate species, bifunctional enzymes profoundly shape the dynamical landscape of the networks in which they appear.
